description: Dataset_Feeder-bus network related to urban rail transit is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Jing Xu, Lianbo Deng (Beijing Jiaotong University). The dataset can be used to deal with the optimization design of feeder-bus network related to urban rail transit. The research on the optimization design of feeder-bus network related to urban rail transit is helpful to improve passengers' travel satisfaction and convenience, and solve the connection problem between rail transit station and bus stop. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
